lines: Switch tabs mid-ride, and Telo Ride keeps the true time. Come back ten minutes later, and nothing has drifted.
A hidden tab's timers run once a minute. The bike keeps talking, and the ride keeps its own clock.
Shown again, the race is at ten ten, in the second recovery, with the distance a visible tab would show.
A class ride does the same: the clock and the segment are exactly where they should be.
And a running race now asks before the tab closes, as a class already did.
The race after ten hidden minutes, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: ten throttled minutes, and the clock, segment and distance stay true.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
